spiritual_reading: The Divine established governing order within wisdom, holding authority in clear discernment, and brought forth what had been inwardly willed into determinate expression. But when a dominant falsity is forcibly restrained so it can no longer speak or act, the allied powers that depend on it begin to fail, and the capacity for coherent action is broken into fragments. Yet even then, something remains within the interior that can still receive further ordering and restoration, though the mode of that remaining receptivity is unclear from what survives of the text.

fills.notes: The substrate sense here is the impersonal setting of order: the Divine sets a governing arrangement before mention of the throne. This matches the spiritual context ‘established governing order within wisdom’ and avoids later exhortatory tone.

The clause must express the fixing of authority in the Light. ‘And set’ gives the required governing placement that the spiritual sense calls ‘holding authority in clear discernment’. The surviving final ‘w’ is satisfied by the following ‘which’.

The context says what was inwardly willed was ‘uttered’ into determinate expression. In the oldest register this is not preaching but decree or command: a word that structures the lower. This fits immediately after ‘he had also uttered’.

After ‘When that one will be muzzled’ the dependent allies lose function. ‘Be cut off’ corresponds to separation of supporting powers from their head, matching the spiritual sense ‘allied powers that depend on it begin to fail’.
The next phrase ‘cut limb ...’ implies dismemberment from a body. ‘From them’ supplies the needed relational break: coherent action is broken into fragments, limb from limb.

The closing needs a remainder within the interior that can still receive restoration. In the oldest cosmological idiom this is a remaining ‘measure’ or ‘portion’ of order within the mixture, consistent with the spiritual sense ‘something remains… that can still receive further ordering’.

assessment: Most gaps can be constrained by the correspondential sequence: establishment of governing order, authoritative setting in Light, decree as utterance, then restraint of dominant falsity leading to severing and dismemberment, yet a remaining measure receptive to re-ordering. Exact connective particles and some brief phrases remain tentative due to minimal surviving natural-sense syntax.
